prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-rare collectible anime character card for an underwater fantasy idol/healer theme, featuring シロイルカ as a smiling beluga-whale girl companion character.

Canvas: Vertical trading-card layout, 4:5 ratio, pastel iridescent fantasy style, high detail, glossy gacha-game SSR presentation. Fill the full image with an ornate pearly frame, shell and jewel decorations, rainbow highlights, bubbles, sparkles, and soft underwater caustic lighting.

Main subject: Center-right anime girl with short fluffy bob hair in pale pink fading to aqua blue at the ends, large sparkling turquoise eyes, light blush, open happy smile, and small white beluga-like animal ears. Add exactly 5 visible hair accessories: one pink flower clip, one blue rectangular hair clip, one small blue dolphin charm clip, one pink bobby pin, and one tiny pearl-like accent. She wears an off-shoulder translucent frilly dress in white, lavender, and aqua with sheer sleeves, pearl straps, star details, a shell choker, dangling charms, and a large iridescent bow at the waist. Her right hand touches her cheek in a cute pose. Beside her on the lower right, include exactly 1 smiling white beluga whale with an open mouth looking up at her.

Background: Dreamy aquarium ocean scene with blue water, coral, sea plants, tiny orange fish, bubbles, glowing particles, and jellyfish. Include exactly 3 prominent jellyfish: one pink jellyfish near the upper right, one blue-white jellyfish at mid-right, and one smaller glowing jellyfish below it. Keep the mood healing, gentle, rare, and magical.

Card frame and UI layout: Top-left has exactly 6 large gold stars. Below the stars, place the large Japanese name text シロイルカ in thick white letters with blue-purple outline. Under the name, add a purple rarity bar with exactly 5 small white stars and the label 「(極上レア)」. Top-right has a circular ornate badge reading 「図鑑番号」 and No.0777.

Left information panels: Include exactly 2 ornate cream panels in the upper-left/middle-left. Panel 1 title: 「性格タイプ」, content: 「癒し系・天然」. Panel 2 title: 「特技」, include a simple line icon of a beluga and the text 「オーロラメロディ」 plus smaller text 「優しい歌声で みんなの心を溶かす♪」.

Bottom stats: Include exactly 3 small rounded stat bars stacked at the lower-left. Bar 1 reads 「出現率」 and 0.7%. Bar 2 reads 「色違い」 and 「オーロラ」. Bar 3 reads 「好感度」 and 「♥ 0~100」.

Bottom quote ribbon: Across the bottom, add a pink rounded message ribbon with shell icons and sparkles. Text reads 一緒にゆらゆら…今日もいっぱい癒してあげるね〜♪.

Visual style: Pastel kawaii anime illustration, luminous watercolor gradients, iridescent pearlescent materials, intricate decorative borders, soft glow, high-resolution card-game UI, cute rare gacha-card aesthetic. Ensure all text is legible and do not add extra panels, extra stars, extra whales, or additional stat rows.
